name: Comfort Employment
summary: Domestic helper agency option for families navigating first-time MDW employment, SIP booking, and insurance floors.
body: Compare at least two FDW agencies on total cost, not headline placement fees. Budget for Settling-In Programme within seven days for first-time helpers (she cannot start work before SIP), enhanced medical insurance at MOM’s ≥S$60k inpatient floor, personal accident cover, security bond timing for non-Malaysian helpers, and a buffer month for mismatch. Transfers skip SIP but often cost more in salary. Ask who pays SIP fees, who books the six-monthly medical, and whether dental is excluded from the insurance quote. Pair with the MDW hiring guide before you treat ‘helper included’ as cheap childcare — most EP+DP households miss the S$60 levy concession.
